auth.headline: Claim rejected? Let's fight it together.
auth.subhead: We read your documents, explain the rejection in your language, and file the appeal for you.
auth.privacy: A one-time code is sent to your phone. We never share your documents.
auth.featureRead: Reads your rejection letter and policy
auth.featureExplain: Explains the rejection in your language
auth.featureFile: Files and tracks your appeal to resolution

start.title: Start your claim
start.heroSub: Tell us where you are and we'll route every step to the right regulator, forms and deadlines.
start.countryNote: This changes the dispute body, forms, currency, deadlines and rejection codes.

upload.title: Talk to Kavach
upload.greeting: Hi, I'm Kavach. Upload your rejection letter and policy — or tell me what happened — and I'll build your appeal.
upload.inputPlaceholder: Tell me what happened, or attach documents…
upload.needDocs: I can't read that yet without your papers. Please attach your rejection letter and policy.
upload.acknowledged: Got it. Attach your rejection letter and policy whenever you're ready and I'll get to work.

summary.title: What happened
summary.notReadySub: We're still working through your papers. Check back in a moment.
summary.noReason: We couldn't find a stated reason in your documents.

chances.title: Your chances
chances.notReadySub: We haven't assessed your case yet.

letter.title: Appeal letter
letter.notReadySub: We haven't drafted your appeal yet.

filing.title: Filing pack
filing.name: Full name
filing.notReadySub: Save your details to generate the pack.

hearing.title: Hearing rehearsal
hearing.introSub: A live voice coach will listen and give you feedback in real time.
hearing.tip1: Use the exact dates on your documents. Don't guess.
hearing.tip2: Stick to facts. If you don't know, say "I don't know".
hearing.tip3: Keep answers short — one or two sentences.

tracker.title: Case tracker
tracker.replySub: What did the insurer or dispute body say?

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.sub: Your appeal is resolved. Keep a copy of your documents.
outcome.deleteSub: Erase this case and every uploaded document. This cannot be undone.
outcome.deleteConfirmSub: All documents will be permanently erased.
